title: SELGRA launches a microgravity learning circle
description: A new monthly peer-learning format will connect students, educators and early-career researchers exploring space life sciences and analogue mission design.

title: Call for short case studies: human factors in isolated environments
description: Members and guests are invited to submit short fictionalized teaching cases for a public resource on teamwork, cognition and wellbeing in extreme environments.

title: Biomedical innovation forum recap
description: The latest SELGRA forum focused on wearable sensors, remote monitoring workflows and ethical design for health technologies in constrained environments.

title: New mentoring pathway for interdisciplinary teams
description: A mock mentoring pathway pairs learners with fictional experts across data science, medicine, education and research operations.
